name: Arekta Rock Band

global_influences.evidence: The band's best-known song 'Eden' is reported as drawing on the video game GTA: Vice City — an influence vector from global entertainment media rather than from a musical act, and one with no equivalent in the founding-era or metal-era catalogue.
global_influences.source: The Business Standard feature, 'Arekta Rock Band: Music to break free from the shackles of the mundane'

local_adaptation_notes: The band's name is a Bangla translation of its own English-language messenger-group name ('Just Another Rock Band'), a small but telling instance of the 2010s pattern in which the English framing comes first and the Bangla is the deliberate localisation.
sound_evolution_summary: Formed 2018 out of the earlier band Hash; built an audience on singles ('Eden', 'Chaap', the duet 'Ojana') before releasing the eight-track album 'Ghum Paranor Gaan' at its first solo show — a singles-first, album-later release order characteristic of the streaming era and the inverse of the cassette-era pattern.
concert_culture_notes: Appeared at the Joy Bangla Concert in 2020 and 2023; launched its debut album at its own headline show ('Arekta Rock Show') rather than through a label campaign.
listener_community_notes: Young, digital-first audience; the band is one of the clearest cases in the catalogue of a career built on streaming singles and self-promoted headline shows.
